known_hazards.detail: Projected (ID & 7) cannot equal 259/260; coherent later mask uses ID & 0x107.
Null replies and success can collapse to the same scalar; setHome mutates host state after failed/null transport; uninitialized/null switch paths can be interpreted as home.
Null reads can return cached/default values; set target can return success-like zero on null; lid null branch dereferences array; wrapper PWM status is discarded.
Projected (location != A || location != B) predicates are always true.
Projected null-X-board branch calls moveX(y) instead of moving Y.
Null door board can return true and ControlLib can cache requested state despite failed confirmation; close recovery homes without retrying close.
loadConfig assigns backing serial directly; selected XML door-open 18500 differs from setter default 16000.
Projected Y/Z existing-value branches use m_xSelfTestTravel.
OEM logs and continues on missing config and suppresses master-position/offset errors; Linux may not silently activate defaults for serial 206.
Projected gripper +10000 move occurs before later null guard.
Both calls are identical setTCorLidPWM(0,0), not separate nest/lid selectors.
Finished messages are emitted after queueing; STA applies timeout per handle while non-STA applies one WaitAll timeout.
Pinned raw IL resolves the TC/RC barcode offset movement and ControlLib.parkGantry(false) contracts despite unsafe-enum/cast artifacts in the decompiled projection.

Unsafe enum/cast regions in unrelated cover and vision inspection methods remain projection evidence, not recompilable authority. The barcode/Park raw-IL resolution does not close this global vision hazard.
CameraControlParameter.Gain is loaded from the selected profile but AdjustCamera does not apply it.
Projected nonzero query24voltage path clears EnclosureDoorClosed and returns false; only zero reaches true.

The projected Decode path removes framing/checksum bytes, unescapes payload, and returns true without visibly checking delimiters or checksum. Preserve OEM vectors, but Linux must validate frame boundaries and checksum before accepting a reply and label that behavior as a reviewed safety deviation.
